opening.opening_summary: A Protoss opening that prioritizes heavy economy and technology investment while maintaining a flexible posture. Early game focuses on developing infrastructure and tech, with a gradual shift toward a ground-oriented army composition in the midgame. The opening is designed to support multiple transition paths, including ground-based compositions with Colossus or High Templar, or a mixed air-ground approach with Phoenix.
